// Store Google Translate's change event
trackChange = null;
pageDelayed = 1500;
// Overwrite prototype to snoop, reset after we find it (keep this right before Translate init)
Element.prototype._addEventListener = Element.prototype.addEventListener;
Element.prototype.addEventListener = function(a,b,c) {
reset = false;
// Filter out first change event
if (a == 'change'){
trackChange = b;
reset = true;
}
if(c==undefined)
c=false;
this._addEventListener(a,b,c);
if(!this.eventListenerList)
this.eventListenerList = {};
if(!this.eventListenerList[a])
this.eventListenerList[a] = [];
this.eventListenerList[a].push({listener:b,useCapture:c});
if (reset){
Element.prototype.addEventListener = Element.prototype._addEventListener;
}

function googleTranslateElementInit() {
// new google.translate.TranslateElement({ pageLanguage: 'en', includedLanguages: 'de,es,fr,it,pt,zh-CN,zh-TW,ar,bn,ht,ja,ko,ru', layout: google.translate.TranslateElement.InlineLayout.SIMPLE}, 'google_translate_element');

let second = $('#google_translate_element-mobile');
let nowChanging = false;

setTimeout(function(){

// Clone the Translate select
second.html(first.clone());
second.find('select').val(select.val());
// Add our own event change

if (nowChanging == false){

}

});
second.find('select').on('change', function(event){
if (nowChanging){
return;

nowChanging = true;
first.find('select').val($(this).val());
trackChange();
// Give this some timeout in case changing events try to hit each other
setTimeout(function(){
nowChanging = false;
}, 1000);
});
}, pageDelayed);

<div class="marketing-module-3-info">
<a href="https://lincolncenter.org/venue/david-geffen-hall/fire-andmiddot-guitar-andmiddot-legend">
<h2 class="marketing-module-header">FIRE · GUITAR · LEGEND · Royal Opera of Spain</h2>
</a>
Madrid&rsquo;s Teatro Real &mdash; Royal Opera of Spain is embarking on a new tour of the US, marking its second visit to the Lincoln Center.An unforgettable evening featuring Joaqu&iacute;n Rodrigo&rsquo;s famous Concierto de Aranjuez, performed by master guitarist Juan Manuel Ca&ntilde;izares. Works by Manuel de Falla will also be performed with soprano Adriana Gonz&aacute;lez. Nikolay Rimsky-Korsakov&rsquo;s legendary Scheherazade will bring the programme to a close, with the Orchestra of the Teatro Real conducted by Gustavo Gimeno.
</div>

<div class="happenings-highlights">
<h2 class="happenings-title">
Where artists and audiences connect
</h2>


<div class="happening-highlight">

<div class="highlight-image">

<img class="sixteen-nine-img" src="https://images.lincolncenter.org/image/upload/v1786988448/v95wnmk5hihwjiej7ix1.png" alt="" />

</div>

<div class="highlight-info">

 <h3 class="highlight-happening-title">Be moved by the arts this Fall</h3>

Get closer to the extraordinary artistic legacy of San Juan Hill with our annual <a href="https://lincolncenter.org/series/lincoln-center-presents/s/Legacies%20of%20San%20Juan%20Hill%20Festival"><em>Legacies of San Juan Hill</em></a> festival celebrating the community and luminaries who shaped this storied neighborhood, where Lincoln Center now stands. And discover new talent at the <a href="https://www.lincolncenter.org/series/lincoln-center-presents/s/Festival%20of%20Firsts"><em>Festival of Firsts</em></a>, spotlighting performers boldly exploring new artistic territory.
</div>
</div>



<div class="happening-highlight">

<div class="highlight-image">

<img class="sixteen-nine-img" src="https://images.lincolncenter.org/image/upload/v1786988410/azrjztxyf9xamy5wc7ri.png" alt="" />

</div>

<div class="highlight-info">

 <h3 class="highlight-happening-title">Encounters that bring you closer, all season long</h3>

<p>Each <em>Lincoln Center Presents</em> series and festival delves deeply into one art form, one body of work, or one theme through performance. This year, we invite you to spend the season with groundbreaking trumpeter, composer, educator, and visionary founder of Jazz at Lincoln Center, <a href="https://lincolncenter.org/series/about/s/Lincoln%20Center%20Visionary%20Artist:%20Wynton%20Marsalis">Wynton Marsalis</a>. And in January, we bring dance home with NYC-based choreographers at the <a href="https://lincolncenter.org/series/lincoln-center-presents/s/Lincoln%20Center%20Contemporary%20Dance%20Festival"><em>Lincoln Center Contemporary Dance Festival</em></a>. <a href="https://lincolncenter.org/series/lincoln-center-presents/v/series">Explore all Series and Festivals.</a></p>

</div>
</div>



<div class="happening-highlight">

<div class="highlight-image">

<img class="sixteen-nine-img" src="https://images.lincolncenter.org/image/upload/v1787081600/avuy35hwapwkvxvz1bmp.jpg" alt="" />

</div>

<div class="highlight-info">

 <h3 class="highlight-happening-title">Sparking curiosity, at every age</h3>

Our Kids, Teens, and Family programming offers a variety of experiences, including lively music concerts, hands-on workshops, sensory-friendly performances, and more. With our FREE or Choose-What-You-Pay ticket offerings throughout the year, accessing the arts has never been easier. So, whether you want to spark your child&rsquo;s imagination or fuel your teen&rsquo;s creativity, we welcome all ages to our stages.&nbsp;<a href="/series/lincoln-center-presents/s/Kids,%20Teens,%20and%20Families">Find programs for Kids, Teens, and Families &raquo;</a>
</div>
</div>


</div>

<div class="marketing-module-3-image">
<a href="https://lincolncenter.org/series/west-initiative/west-initiative">
<img class="sixteen-nine-img" src="https://images.lincolncenter.org/image/upload/v1747670211/z9ujsi0nybpgtfjrfu1y.jpg" alt=""/>
</a>
</div>

<div class="marketing-module-3-info">
<a href="https://lincolncenter.org/series/west-initiative/west-initiative">
<h2 class="marketing-module-header">Opening up the West Side of Lincoln Center</h2>
</a>
The Stavros Niarchos Foundation (SNF) Lincoln Center West Initiative opens up the Amsterdam Avenue side of Lincoln Center&rsquo;s campus, creating a more welcoming edge on the west side. The new design incorporates extensive community feedback from an ongoing participatory process that began in 2023. Features include: welcoming entrance that dramatically opens up Amsterdam Avenue to neighbors approaching from the west; community park featuring a lawn, water feature, tree groves and garden for public enjoyment; and new, world-class amphitheater that will improve artist and audience experiences. <a href="https://lincolncenter.org/series/west-initiative/west-initiative">Explore the new design and learn more &raquo;</a>
</div>
